verdict.rationale: Termius ships a built-in AI widget that turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands (docs-6, docs-45). That is a genuine first-party AI feature, but it only generates single commands rather than taking on delegated, multi-step tasks. missing for 10: evidence of agentic task delegation (multi-step planning and execution, acting across hosts or sessions), assistant chat or context awareness beyond command generation, any independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI feature.
